items.item: H11, the direction takes J1/J2, not C
items.how: The crosswalk's 33 fields follow 07 §7's label and the fronts' short form. It missed five fields in three entries and one more entry, now fixed: cx-zhishan-output-with-its-world (targets[0] 'Under the condition, C and J1–J4.' and its reading 'the direction holds only under the continuation condition, C and J1 to J4'), cx-zhishan-do-not-fight-for-us (reading: a direction 'proposed' under 'the continuation condition, C and J1 to J4'; 'proposed' is also no longer 07's word, which is 'offer'), cx-zhishan-corrigible-not-obedient (reading: 'under the continuation condition, C and J1 to J4'). Each now reads 'the continuation condition, J1 to J4 (J1–J4) and a correspondence (correspondence E), with moves compared by widening'. cx-abr-promised-end account_adds gave 'an order ranking by widening' as a premise of CD's direction; now 'a direction as a criterion only, widening, which gives the generative direction where courses are ranked by it, as a self-concerned order ranks them where the continuation condition holds de se; choices take further premises' (CD's answer in brief). Per H11's last clause I checked other results said to take C: 07 §5's practical judgment is 'Conditional (living significance, J1–J4, correspondence E)', so cx-archearth-mechanical-against-ecological-return's 'Preserve is a candidate only, under the continuation condition, an order meeting C and J1-J4' now reads 'under living significance, J1–J4 and correspondence E'; the relation-level law of easing ('Conditional (C, for the ranking)'), ranking under readings ('Conditional (C; World)') and organizational formation (its reading takes an order meeting C) do take C, and the entries saying so stand.

cx-fork-no-real-externality targets[1] (CD §4) said 'Order: C, calling a widening course better.', the withdrawn frame, untouched by this pass. Now CD §4's own content: 'the condition by itself orders nothing; where it holds de se, self-concern ranks every widening above what it widens on a finite listing and, with admission decided, between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list; elsewhere each ranking result names the requirement on an order it takes: C (`Comparison`) in many, J1 and J2 in the direction's, self-concern alone in some.' No 'unasserted', 'warrant open', 'neither asserted', 'binds no one', 'second premise', 'C giving order' or C-as-better remains in either file; 'two readings' remains only for other things (readings of living, a recorder theorem).
